summary: Ten metres of Carmody Road kerb on a 16% slope beside a bush bank.
reasons: Bank and trees right at lane edge

best_section.where: south side of Carmody Road, west of the bus-zone end, below a wooded bank

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense bush; apartments and houses 16-17 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sloping bank and trees meet the lane edge; no clear ground to pull fully off. Section is only 10 m, shorter than a van.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P parallel parking signs, with a few cars parked on the north side only.

flags: Traffic noise from a through road
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the verge, shaded from the south and west.
